Subject: Next Steps: Aligning Deep Dive Timing & Attendees

Hi Samira —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our discovery:

- Scope: evaluate Redwood for low-latency inference on your multi-tenant stream processing workloads (50–200 qps peak).
- Success criteria you called out: < 150ms tail latency for p95, per-route cost budget, and audit logging for SOC-like needs.
- Next step: schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep dive with your infra and backend engineering leads so we can validate integration points (KV cache strategy, autoscaling policies, and VPC peering).

I have two windows that look good on our side:
1) Tue Oct 5 — 10:00–11:15 AM PT (we can stretch to 75m)
2) Wed Oct 6 — 1:00–2:15 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works best, and who from your team should join (names + roles)? Also let us know whether you prefer Google Meet or Zoom for the session — we can send the calendar invite once attendees/bridge are confirmed.

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) draft that captures the sequence we discussed; we can iterate on it during the deep dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
